006package dev.metaschema.core.model.constraint;
007
008import java.util.Collection;
009import java.util.List;
010import java.util.stream.Collectors;
011import java.util.stream.Stream;
012
013import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node.IModuleNodeItem;
014import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node.INodeItemFactory;
015import dev.metaschema.core.model.IModule;
016import dev.metaschema.core.model.IModuleLoader;
017import dev.metaschema.core.model.constraint.impl.ConstraintComposingVisitor;
018import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
019import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
020
021/**
022 * A module loading post processor that integrates applicable external
023 * constraints into a given module when loaded.
024 *
025 * @see IModuleLoader
026 */
027public class ExternalConstraintsModulePostProcessor implements IModuleLoader.IModulePostProcessor {
028  @NonNull
029  private final List<IConstraintSet> registeredConstraintSets;
030
031  /**
032   * Create a new post processor.
033   *
034   * @param additionalConstraintSets
035   *          the external constraint sets to apply
036   */
037  public ExternalConstraintsModulePostProcessor(@NonNull Collection<IConstraintSet> additionalConstraintSets) {
038    this.registeredConstraintSets = ObjectUtils.notNull(additionalConstraintSets.stream()
039        .flatMap(set -> Stream.concat(
040            Stream.of(set),
041            set.getImportedConstraintSets().stream()))
042        .distinct()
043        .collect(Collectors.toUnmodifiableList()));
044  }
045
046  /**
047   * Get the external constraint sets associated with this post processor.
048   *
049   * @return the list of constraint sets
050   */
051  protected List<IConstraintSet> getRegisteredConstraintSets() {
052    return registeredConstraintSets;
053  }
054
055  @Override
056  public void processModule(IModule module) {
057    ConstraintComposingVisitor visitor = new ConstraintComposingVisitor();
058    IModuleNodeItem moduleItem = INodeItemFactory.instance().newModuleNodeItem(module);
059
060    for (IConstraintSet set : getRegisteredConstraintSets()) {
061      assert set != null;
062      set.applyConstraintsForModule(moduleItem, visitor);
063    }
064  }
065}
